### F1. Five old issues in To do and In progress state no acceptance criteria or limits

- **Failure:** The maintainer takes [[MAIN-44]], [[MAIN-45]] or [[MAIN-48]] from To do and cannot tell when the work is done. [[MAIN-50]] and [[MAIN-51]] sit in In progress without a criterion. [[MAIN-45]] still leaves the display of partial weeks "to be decided".
- **Evidence:** inspected — `.github/roadmap/MAIN-P1.md` puts the five cards in To do and In progress. The files `MAIN-44.md`, `MAIN-45.md`, `MAIN-48.md`, `MAIN-50.md` and `MAIN-51.md` hold no criteria list and no limits.
- **Fix:** Rewrite each of the five with the expected behavior, the limits and checkable criteria, or move it to Backlog until it has them.

### F2. MAIN-177 repeats the `.env` deliverable and criterion that MAIN-187 also holds

- **Failure:** Two In progress issues own the same change. [[MAIN-187]] lists the `.env` change and the `contribution lookup` criterion of [[MAIN-177]]. [[MAIN-183]] owns the other part, `--token`, so the maintainer verifies and ticks one change twice.
- **Evidence:** inspected — the `.env` bullet and the fifth criterion of `.github/issues/MAIN-187.md` match the first criterion of `.github/issues/MAIN-177.md`; MAIN-177 defers `--token` to MAIN-183.
- **Fix:** Merge the `.env` work into one issue, so that each criterion lives in exactly one of MAIN-177 and MAIN-187.

### F3. The files and GitHub differ in issues, bodies, milestones and milestone fields

- **Failure:** Until publication, `verify` lists 24 local-only issues, 18 bodies, 25 milestone fields and three milestone titles, so a real drift would hide among them.
- **Evidence:** inspected — `maintainer.py verify` reports 24 local-only issues, body differs 18, milestone differs 25, and MAIN-M1 to MAIN-M3 titles differ.
- **Fix:** Sync the mirror with GitHub once the owner publishes the new issues and the milestone redesign.
